caption: The drawing depicts a single object: a twisted rope or cord, rendered in shades of brown, stretching horizontally across the center of a light beige or off-white background. The rope appears to have a consistent thickness and exhibits shading to indicate its coiled and textured nature. At each end of the rope, there are metal attachments. The left end has a circular metal loop with a small decorative element hanging beneath it, connected by a metal fitting. The right end features a T-bar style metal fitting, also attached by a metal fitting and joint. Near the center of the rope, there is a decorative metal element, possibly a clasp or ornament, that interrupts the continuous brown twist and is rendered in a brass or gold color. The artist's signature, "Edna Boye," is inscribed in the bottom right corner of the image. The composition is minimalistic, with the rope slightly bowed in the shape of a shallow arc, and the background is blank, with no additional objects or decorations present.
title: Watch Chain
